about: The owner asked for a knowledge agent that stores and categorises every input, extracts its knowledge into knowledge files through a many-to-many map of files and concepts, keeps layered How it works summaries up to date after every input or system change, and may create new docs where nothing fits.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
